format: Makefile (with embedded definitions for kernel modules)
description: This file defines kernel package configurations for Broadcom Northstar USB PHY drivers (USB 2.0 and USB 3.0), and a Broadcom iProc I2C controller module for the OpenWrt Linux-based project. It specifies package metadata, dependencies, associated kernel module files, and auto-loading instructions.

methods.name: call AutoLoad
methods.description: Function used to specify automatic module loading instructions during kernel initialization.
